purpose: Define leakage-safe feature selection before Candidate V2 implementation.
candidateV2Plan: Recalibrate lane-1 prior instead of removing lane prior.
Represent racer strength as relative field and inner-vs-outer gaps.
Represent ST as relative lane/field differences rather than raw value only.
Represent local performance and motor strength as relative gaps.
Build confidence from probability concentration plus structural strength, not nearest-distance alone.
Run old-vs-candidate strict walk-forward on identical historical targets.
Promote only if holdout improves without unacceptable ROI/drawdown deterioration.
notes: Do not tune thresholds on holdout outcomes.
Do not use same-day results to alter PRE-RACE predictions.
Exhibition remains reserved for the separate second-candidate path.
